finding: Allocation counted any retained matching interceptor state until its original deadline, including finished state. Changed gunner or released fire lease could therefore still discourage coverage of that missile.
implementation: Coverage retains original bounded platform list and requires unfinished state, original matching missile/epoch/deadline, living local platform, original living local main gunner in group, and exact original fire lease. No current episode is retargeted or renewed.
limits: Coverage is a current reservation observation, not native fire, hit or interception evidence.
Existing default-off experimental main-turret scope and warning/shot/step budgets remain.
